enrichment method: Flag affinity resins with or without Flag-tagged MFN2 coating (MFN2-beads) were incubated with cell lysates at 4°C overnight. Beads were washed five times with RIPA buffer and eluted with 400 μg/mL Flag peptide. The eluted protein samples were subjected to SDS-PAGE or MS analysis.
labeling: Subsequent LC-MS/MS identified several Rab proteins, among which Rab5A, Rab21, and Rab5C were the most enriched
